name: tinkerer-club
title: Tinkerer Club
description: Browse and participate in Tinkerer Club from Raycast, with confirmable AI tools.
author: Olli0103

commands.name: search-tinkerer
commands.title: Search Club
commands.description: Search members, posts, topics, projects, and other club content.

commands.name: browse-prompts
commands.title: Browse Prompts
commands.description: Search, inspect, and copy prompts shared by the club.

commands.name: browse-feed
commands.title: Browse Feed
commands.description: Read posts and comments, reply, and react without leaving Raycast.

commands.name: browse-articles
commands.title: Browse Articles
commands.description: Search published articles, read full posts, and inspect your drafts.

commands.name: quick-post
commands.title: Quick Post
commands.description: Publish, queue, or save a short Tinkerer Club post.

commands.name: browse-api
commands.title: Browse API
commands.description: Browse and run procedures from the live Tinkerer Club API catalog.

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Tinkerer Club Menu Bar
commands.description: See recent feed activity and articles, then open common Tinkerer actions.

tools.name: get-feed
tools.title: Get Tinkerer Feed
tools.description: Get the latest posts from the authenticated member's Tinkerer Club feed.

tools.name: get-articles
tools.title: Get Tinkerer Articles
tools.description: Search published Tinkerer Club articles for Raycast AI.

tools.name: search-club
tools.title: Search Tinkerer Club
tools.description: Search Tinkerer Club members, posts, topics, projects, and other club content.

tools.name: get-post
tools.title: Get Tinkerer Conversation
tools.description: Get one Tinkerer Club post and its comments by post ID.

tools.name: comment-on-post
tools.title: Comment on Tinkerer Post
tools.description: Post a comment or reply after showing the user a confirmation.

tools.name: react
tools.title: React on Tinkerer Club
tools.description: Add or remove a reaction on a post or comment after showing the user a confirmation.

preferences.name: baseUrl
preferences.title: Platform Base URL
preferences.description: The HTTPS origin that serves /api/v1, without a trailing API path.

preferences.name: authorizationValue
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: A member API key created in Tinkerer Club Settings. It is sent in the x-api-key header.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run lint && npm run build
